mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 for positive returns when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate hiring and earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a contraction in real economic activity, reducing corporate revenue visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS and INDPRO both decline, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, robust real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars signals sustained consumer strength that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars is not associated with positive 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 305 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as risk premiums rise.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 305, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above its 3-year moving average, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0% annualized) signals a healthy economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL < 3.0%, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth rate below 50,000 jobs signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate hiring, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS falls below 50,000, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year window.
